artifacts.summary: Designs a whole-Bash-call stash-set-diffing provenance mechanism (new PostToolUse record-stash-provenance.sh hook + a prelude in guard-destructive-git.sh) to scope git stash pop/apply to session-created entries, reusing the existing push-grant consent primitive for the foreign-entry ask-the-user path, and enumerates the required fixture and doc updates.

memory_candidates.content: This codebase's hook-authoring convention for per-session state: key state files by Claude Code's own native top-level stdin field `.session_id` (CC_SESSION_ID), validated against ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ before use in a path, stored under .claude/tmp/<purpose>-<CC_SESSION_ID>, with an env-var override (e.g. NOOP_BASH_STATE_DIR) so tests never write into the source store's own tmp/. Precedent: hooks/detect-noop-bash.sh and hooks/subagent-postflight.sh (cc_session_id correlation).

guard-destructive-git.sh's PreToolUse hook only ever observes the literal top-level tool_input.command string of the Bash call actually invoked -- any git subcommand run as a subprocess INSIDE a wrapper script (e.g. git-snapshot.sh's internal `git stash push -u`) is structurally invisible to literal command-text pattern matching. A provenance/ownership mechanism that needs to cover both direct agent commands and such wrapper-internal calls must diff observable state (e.g. git stash list before/after the WHOLE Bash call) rather than pattern-match command text.

The consent-gated push-grant primitive (push-grant-lib.sh PG_ACTION_CLASSES + please-grant.sh's destructive-form case block + guard-destructive-git.sh's class-generic grant-check block at ~lines 550-577) is designed to be extended by registering a new ACTION_CLASS name at exactly two wiring points (PG_ACTION_CLASSES for validation, please-grant.sh's case/accepted-forms text for mintability) -- no new consent mechanism is needed for a new local-destructive-action class; it reuses the existing REMOTE=local/REF=<branch or HEAD>/FORCE=0 sentinel shape that stash_drop/stash_revert already use.
